profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Recent Computer Science grad from the University of Florida, diving into the software engineering world. Equipped with a solid foundation in programming, data structures, OS design, and Agile methodology. Have experience with React in front-end development, but excited to explore and learn more about back-end too. Open to all opportunities as I find my niche in this exciting field. Feel free to connect!

positions.locationName: Miami Gardens, Florida, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained React web applications, focusing on performance optimization and enhanced user experience.
• Devised a reusable UI solution that was subsequently adopted for all future feature implementations.
• Practiced Test-Driven Development (TDD) using Jest and React Testing Library, achieving more than 80% unit test coverage for new and legacy code to ensure software quality and reliability.
• Managed Git codebases for effective team collaboration and enhanced code quality through peer code reviews.
positions.insights: Software Development, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +15 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to software development projects under the guidance of experienced engineers.
• Provided valuable insights and suggestions to the company’s management during presentations.
• Restructured and cleaned up legacy code.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Unit Testing and +16 skills

positions.title: Search Engine and Web app Evaluator
positions.description:
• Improved the relevance of AI-powered products and search engines.
• Trained digital assistants in language and dialect recognition.
• Assisted in overcoming machine-learning barriers and fostered global human-learning connections.

projects.title: Moodipy (Backend Role)
projects.description:
• Developed Moodipy, a Spotify-connected tool generating playlists based on user moods or preferences.
• Implemented an algorithm for playlist generation based on user mood and prediction of potential popular songs. 
• Stacks:  Spotify API, Python, Django

projects.title: Senior Database (Front End Role)
projects.description:
• Developed a full-stack web application to assist the University of Florida students and faculty in managing CIS4914 Senior Projects.
• Handled login, project posting/searching forms, messaging, database enhancement, and debugging.
